text_block_list.text:
The trio of Biwa Hayahide, Narita Taishin, 
and Winning Ticket came to be known as 
"BNW," garnering widespread public 
attention.

The first race of the Classic Triple Crown 
route, where they would all gather in one 
place: the Satsuki Sho.

Driven by their fierce resolve to claim 
victory, they headed into the race fired 
up to the max.
